card.name: Body parts in positioning instructions
card.fires_on: Body-part words (arm, foot, hand, wrist, palms) and words leading to them, in step-by-step instructions on positioning or placing a limb or the body.

modes.label: Limb named in positioning
modes.description: A limb or hand part is named while telling how to place the patient or arm.
modes.example: The<< arm>> should be positioned with the elbow flexed

modes.label: Where on the body
modes.description: A word that leads to a body part in directions for taking a pulse, giving an injection or locating an implant.
modes.example: Take your pulse on the inside of your<< wrist>>, on the thumb side.

card.plain: It lights up on body parts like arm, hand or wrist when instructions say how to position or where to place something.
